name: ignition-sandbox
description: MCP server for testing Ignition GitHub Pages sandbox

tools.name: sandbox_ping
tools.description: Check if GitHub Pages sandbox is accessible and responding

tools.name: sandbox_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a specific file from the sandbox and return status/hash

path.description: File path relative to sandbox root (e.g., 'index.html')

tools.name: sandbox_sync_check
tools.description: Check if local repo version matches deployed GitHub Pages version

file.description: File to check sync status for

tools.name: sandbox_sync_watch
tools.description: Watch and wait for repo changes to sync to GitHub Pages

tools.name: sandbox_run_command
tools.description: Execute a pre-defined command from cli/commands/

tools.name: sandbox_list_commands
tools.description: List all available commands loaded from cli/commands/

tools.name: sandbox_status
tools.description: Get full status report of sandbox including sync state and loaded commands
